author: han0110
content:
I remember the `pk` hint was added to avoid the additional verify inside recovery. `recover_from_prehash` of `ecdsa` (used by `k256`) verifies the signature again after it recovers the key, so it pays the scalar muls twice. The idea came from `zeth` and was introduced to `reth` in https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/17841, some zkVM teams chose to patch the `ecdsa` crate to skip the extra verify e.g. SP1 did  https://github.com/sp1-patches/signatures/commit/5e71deeacc5b62f9cb79f772a94c9f6f36072bfe.

But since now all guests use `zkvm_secp256k1_ecrecover` that already avoids the additional verify, I think we can remove the `pk` hint and the `zkvm_secp256k1_verify` API, should simplify many things.

More details on the algo diff: ecrecover pays additional y-coordinate calculation, verify pays additional pk on-curve check, did a quick cost estimation locally, the net saving of verify is less than 1% of the whole ecrecover.
